manifest.description: Devin2API model provider for DeepSeek Harness
manifest.author: Green-hats

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/client.js && node --check lib/protocol.js && node --check lib/catalog.js && node --check lib/schema.js

bundle.text:
# dsh-devin2api 的 profile 补丁：插入插件行。
# `providers` 字典供 Models 设置页按 provider 编辑（settingsPath = providers.devin2api）。
- insert:
    - id: devin2api
      name: dsh-devin2api
      config:
        providers:
          devin2api:
            displayName: Devin2API
            baseURL: http://127.0.0.1:18089/v1
            apiKeyEnv: DEVIN2API_API_KEY
            enabled: true
            images: true

readme.text: **A model-provider plugin that brings [devin-2api-lite](https://github.com/Green-hats/devin-2api-lite) into [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).**

[](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [](https://github.com/Green-hats/devin-2api-lite) [](package.json) [](LICENSE) [](https://github.com/Green-hats/dsh-devin2api/actions/workflows/ci.yml) English | [中文](README.zh-CN.md) [Quick start](#quick-start) · [Configuration](#configuration) · [Web UI](#web-ui) · [Protocol](#protocol-mapping) · [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting) ---

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The plugin is the **client half**. [devin-2api-lite](https://github.com/Green-hats/devin-2api-lite) owns the Devin
> protocol, catalog, quota and upstream token. Start the gateway first: without it the plugin advertises no models and
> cannot stream.

| Gateway endpoint | Caller | Credential |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET /healthz` | settings panel | none |
| `GET /v1/models` | catalog, discovery | Host `Bearer`; browser none |
| `GET /v1/quota` | quota pill, panel | browser none |
| `POST /v1/chat/completions` | every model call | `Bearer` |
| `POST /__clientlog` | diagnostics | none, local |

- **DeepSeek Harness** 0.2.x (tested `0.2.1-rc.3`); peers `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm >= 0.1.5-rc.1`,
  `@deepseek-ai/schemastery >= 3.18.0`.
- **Node.js** `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`.
- **devin-2api-lite** with `/v1/quota` and CORS on read-only GETs; the Host `attachments` service for images.
```bash

git clone https://github.com/Green-hats/devin-2api-lite.git
cd devin-2api-lite
cp config.example.yaml config.yaml   # set devin.token
go run ./cmd/devin-2api -config config.yaml

readme.section: 2. plugin (restart the profile afterwards, then refresh the page)
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Green-hats/dsh-devin2api

curl -s http://127.0.0.1:18089/healthz
```

Configure it in **Settings → Models → Devin2API**, or override the row in
`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`:
yaml
- id: devin2api
  config:
    providers:
      devin2api:
        baseURL: http://127.0.0.1:18089/v1
        apiKeyEnv: DEVIN2API_API_KEY
```

Then choose **Devin2API** in `/model`.

| Field | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `displayName` | `Devin2API` | Provider name in the selector |
| `baseURL` | `http://127.0.0.1:18089/v1` | Gateway root including `/v1` |
| `apiKey` / `apiKeyEnv` | `''` / `DEVIN2API_API_KEY` | Direct key (redacted) or env var read per request |
| `enabled` | `true` | Mount-time gate; changing it needs a reload |
| `models` | `[]` | Empty = all. Non-empty allowlist of ids or `{ id, name }` |
| `modelVisibility` | `{}` | Per-model switch; `false` hides a model |
| `images` | `true` | Declare image input for vision models |
| `contextWindow` / `maxTokens` | `262144` / `128000` | The window comes per model from `/v1/models` `context_length` (fallback here); `maxTokens` is the global output reservation |
| `modelMaxTokens` | `{ "swe-2": 65536 }` | Per-model output reservation (id or family prefix). SWE-2's 262k window with a 128k reservation would compact at ~26% |
| `refreshMinutes` | `5` | Catalog cache TTL (minimum 1) |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | `300000` | Per-request timeout including the stream |
| `imagePixelBudget` / `imageMaxBytes` | `4194304` / `1048576` | Resize target per image |
| `maxRequestImageBytes` | `20971520` | Total base

All fields except `enabled` are volatile: settings writes apply live. `DEVIN2API_BASE_URL` is reported to the Models
page as an endpoint hint.

_The real Settings → Devin2API page and the composer pill (UI copy is Chinese). [Full-size settings](docs/settings.jpg)._ - **Settings → Devin2API** — gateway status, daily/weekly quota, catalog switches and refresh. - **Settings → Models → Devin2API** — base URL, key, images, model discovery. - **Composer pill** — only for a `devin2api` model; 60 s poll; click to request `?fresh=1`.

The browser calls `/healthz`, `/v1/models` and `/v1/quota` directly and sends **no** API key. With `auth.api_key`
set, the catalog/panel reads fail (chat still works); read-only settings disable the switches.

- The catalog is cached for `refreshMinutes`, refreshed in a single flight, and falls back to `models`; if both are
  empty it reports `EMPTY_CATALOG`.
- `models` is an allowlist; `modelVisibility` is applied after it. All-off or all-missing falls back to the full list.
- Only the current turn (last `user` message onward) is uploaded. Older images become `[Image omitted from history]`.
- Images are resized per `imagePixelBudget`/`imageMaxBytes`; over `maxRequestImageBytes` fails with `IMAGE_BUDGET`.

| DSH input | Gateway request |
| --- | --- |
| system prompt + leading/mid-history `system` | one or more `system` messages |
| `developer` | `system` |
| user / tool content | string, or `text` + `image_url` parts |
| assistant text / tool calls | `content` + `tool_calls` (JSON-string arguments) |
| tools | OpenAI `function` tools; `deferLoading` skipped |
| `maxTokens` / `reasoningEffort` / `temperature` / `stop` | same-named fields |

Stream: `reasoning_content` → reasoning block, `content` → text, `tool_calls` → tool-call block, `usage` → usage,
`finish_reason` → `stop` / `tool-calls` / `max-tokens`. `[DONE]` ends the stream.

Errors: `AUTH`, `QUOTA`, `INVALID_REQUEST`, `TIMEOUT`, `ABORTED`, `TRANSPORT`, `SERVER`, `IMAGE_BUDGET`,
`IMAGE_UNAVAILABLE`, `EMPTY_CATALOG`, `EMPTY_RESPONSE`, `UPSTREAM_ERROR`.

> Current lite fixes sampling (`max_tokens`, `temperature`, `top_p`, `top_k`) and ignores client values; the plugin
> still forwards `temperature` / `stop` for gateways that honor them.

``` lib/index.js host adapter, registration, discovery, settings policy lib/protocol.js message/tool/SSE translation lib/catalog.js catalog, quota, visibility, error mapping lib/schema.js volatile Config schema

- **`cannot reach the gateway`** — `curl /healthz`, check `baseURL`; the Host must reach it too.
- **`AUTH`** — check `apiKey` / `apiKeyEnv` against lite's `auth.api_key`.
- **Empty model selector** — `curl /v1/models`; set `models` as a fallback; reload the plugin.
- **Images become text** — expected for history; check `images`, `supports_images`, `attachments`, budgets.
- **Settings unavailable** — the namespace needs volatile fields; check the Host log.
- **Pill missing** — model is not `devin2api`, gateway down, CORS blocked, or `auth.api_key` set.
- **Client errors** — `POST /__clientlog`; lite appends to `$TMPDIR/dsh-devin2api-client.log`.

- No replay state; multi-turn replays visible text and tool calls only.
- One gateway per plugin instance.
- `enabled` requires a reload.
- The browser UI is unauthenticated; use a loopback gateway with `auth.api_key` unset.
- UI copy is Chinese-only.
- `contextWindow` is discovered per model from the gateway's `context_length` (newer lite builds); models without it fall back to the configured value. `maxTokens` stays configured, with a bundled `modelMaxTokens` override for `swe-2` (64k) — the gateway exposes no per-model output cap.

```bash
npm install --legacy-peer-deps   # schemastery for the schema tests
npm test                         # 32 tests
npm run check                    # node --check for lib/*.js
```

A test-only resolve hook maps `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` to `test/fixtures/dsh-llm`, so the suite runs without DSH.
Banners, the architecture diagram and the UI composite are generated by `python3 scripts/make-images.py` (needs
`rsvg-convert` and Pillow); `docs/settings.jpg` and `docs/composer.png` are the source screenshots. CI runs Node 22/24.

- [devin-2api-lite](https://github.com/Green-hats/devin-2api-lite) — the gateway
  ([中文](https://github.com/Green-hats/devin-2api-lite/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md))
- [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
- [leookun/devin-2api](https://github.com/leookun/devin-2api) — original protocol research
[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 Green-hats. The Host path is tested against a live lite gateway; the UI composite uses screenshots from a live profile.

**把 [devin-2api-lite](https://github.com/Green-hats/devin-2api-lite) 接入 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的模型提供方插件。** [](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [](https://github.com/Green-hats/devin-2api-lite) [](package.json) [](LICENSE) [](https://github.com/Green-hats/dsh-devin2api/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

[English](README.md) | 中文 [快速开始](#快速开始) · [配置](#配置) · [界面](#界面) · [协议映射](#协议映射) · [排障](#排障) --- > [!IMPORTANT] > 本插件是**客户端半边**。[devin-2api-lite](https://github.com/Green-hats/devin-2api-lite) 负责 Devin 协议、模型目录、 > 额度和上游 token。先启动网关：没有它插件既列不出模型，也无法建立流式请求。

`dsh-devin2api` 在 DeepSeek Harness 中注册提供方路由 **`devin2api`**：目录来自 `GET /v1/models`，请求走
`POST /v1/chat/completions` 并翻译成 DSH 的 `StreamChunk`，同时提供设置页、模型开关和额度胶囊。

- 流式文本、思考、工具调用，错误码稳定；
- 当前轮图片转成缩放、限字节的 data URL；
- 白名单和每模型开关实时生效。

| 网关端点 | 调用方 | 凭据 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET /healthz` | 设置面板 | 无 |
| `GET /v1/models` | 目录、模型发现 | Host 带 `Bearer`；浏览器不带 |
| `GET /v1/quota` | 额度胶囊、面板 | 浏览器不带 |
| `POST /v1/chat/completions` | 每次模型调用 | `Bearer` |
| `POST /__clientlog` | 排障 | 无；仅本地 |

- **DeepSeek Harness** 0.2.x（在 `0.2.1-rc.3` 上验证）；peer 包 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm >= 0.1.5-rc.1`、
  `@deepseek-ai/schemastery >= 3.18.0`。
- **Node.js** `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`。
- **devin-2api-lite**，启用 `/v1/quota` 与只读 GET 的 CORS；图片输入需要 Host 的 `attachments` 服务。
```bash

git clone https://github.com/Green-hats/devin-2api-lite.git
cd devin-2api-lite
cp config.example.yaml config.yaml   # 填入 devin.token
go run ./cmd/devin-2api -config config.yaml

readme.section: 2. 插件（装完重启 profile，再刷新页面）
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Green-hats/dsh-devin2api

curl -s http://127.0.0.1:18089/healthz
```

在 **设置 → 模型 → Devin2API** 里配置，或覆盖
`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` 中的同名行：
yaml
- id: devin2api
  config:
    providers:
      devin2api:
        baseURL: http://127.0.0.1:18089/v1
        apiKeyEnv: DEVIN2API_API_KEY
```

然后在 `/model` 里选择 **Devin2API**。

| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `displayName` | `Devin2API` | 模型选择器里的名字 |
| `baseURL` | `http://127.0.0.1:18089/v1` | 含 `/v1` 的网关根地址 |
| `apiKey` / `apiKeyEnv` | `''` / `DEVIN2API_API_KEY` | 直写密钥（会打码）或每次请求读取的环境变量 |
| `enabled` | `true` | 挂载时判断；修改需重载 |
| `models` | `[]` | 空 = 全部；非空为 id 或 `{ id, name }` 白名单 |
| `modelVisibility` | `{}` | 每模型开关；`false` 表示隐藏 |
| `images` | `true` | 对视觉模型声明图片输入 |
| `contextWindow` / `maxTokens` | `262144` / `128000` | 上下文窗口按模型取网关 `/v1/models` 的 `context_length`，缺失时用这里的值；`maxTokens` 是全局输出预留 |
| `modelMaxTokens` | `{ "swe-2": 65536 }` | 按模型覆盖输出预留（精确 id 或家族前缀）。SWE-2 的 262k 窗口配 128k 会在约 26% 就压缩 |
| `refreshMinutes` | `5` | 目录缓存 TTL（最小 1） |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | `300000` | 单次请求超时（含流） |
| `imagePixelBudget` / `imageMaxBytes` | `4194304` / `1048576` | 单图像素与字节预算 |
| `maxRequestImageBytes` | `20971520` | 单次请求 base64 总字符数 |
除 `enabled` 外都是 volatile 字段：设置页写入立即生效。`DEVIN2API_BASE_URL` 会作为 Models 页的 endpoint 提示。

_设置 → Devin2API 与输入区额度胶囊的真实截图（[完整设置页](docs/settings.jpg)）。_ - **设置 → Devin2API** —— 网关状态、日/周额度、模型目录开关与刷新。 - **设置 → 模型 → Devin2API** —— base URL、密钥、图片能力、模型发现。 - **输入区胶囊** —— 仅选中 `devin2api` 模型时出现；60 秒轮询；点击请求 `?fresh=1`。 浏览器直接请求 `/healthz`、`/v1/models`、`/v1/quota`，**不带** API key。设置 `auth.api_key` 后面板/目录读取会 失败（聊天不受影响）；只读设置下模型开关禁用。

- 目录按 `refreshMinutes` 缓存、单飞刷新；失败回退到 `models`，两者都空则报 `EMPTY_CATALOG`。
- `models` 是白名单，`modelVisibility` 在其后生效；全部关闭或全部失效时回退完整列表。
- 只上传当前轮（最后一条 `user` 消息及其后）的图片；更早的替换为 `[Image omitted from history]`。
- 图片按 `imagePixelBudget` / `imageMaxBytes` 缩放；超过 `maxRequestImageBytes` 报 `IMAGE_BUDGET`。

| DSH 输入 | 网关请求 |
| --- | --- |
| system 提示 + 开头/中段 `system` | 一条或多条 `system` 消息 |
| `developer` | `system` |
| 用户 / tool 内容 | 字符串，或 `text` + `image_url` 分片 |
| assistant 文本 / 工具调用 | `content` + `tool_calls`（JSON 字符串参数） |
| tools | OpenAI `function` 工具；跳过 `deferLoading` |
| `maxTokens` / `reasoningEffort` / `temperature` / `stop` | 同名字段 |

流式：`reasoning_content` → 思考块，`content` → 文本，`tool_calls` → 工具块，`usage` → usage，
`finish_reason` → `stop` / `tool-calls` / `max-tokens`；`[DONE]` 结束。

错误码：`AUTH`、`QUOTA`、`INVALID_REQUEST`、`TIMEOUT`、`ABORTED`、`TRANSPORT`、`SERVER`、`IMAGE_BUDGET`、
`IMAGE_UNAVAILABLE`、`EMPTY_CATALOG`、`EMPTY_RESPONSE`、`UPSTREAM_ERROR`。

> 当前 lite 固定采样参数（`max_tokens`、`temperature`、`top_p`、`top_k`），会忽略客户端值；插件仍会转发
> `temperature` / `stop`，以便对接会尊重这些参数的网关。
``` lib/index.js Host 适配器、注册、模型发现、设置策略 lib/protocol.js 消息/工具/SSE 翻译 lib/catalog.js 目录、额度、可见性、错误映射 lib/schema.js volatile Config schema

- **`cannot reach the gateway`** —— `curl /healthz`、检查 `baseURL`；Host 也必须能访问。
- **`AUTH`** —— 核对 `apiKey` / `apiKeyEnv` 与 lite 的 `auth.api_key`。
- **模型选择器为空** —— `curl /v1/models`；用 `models` 配回退列表；重载插件。
- **图片变成文本** —— 历史图属正常；检查 `images`、`supports_images`、`attachments` 与预算。
- **设置页 unavailable** —— namespace 需要 volatile 字段；看 Host 日志。
- **胶囊不出现** —— 模型不是 `devin2api`、网关未启动、CORS 被拦，或设置了 `auth.api_key`。
- **客户端异常** —— `POST /__clientlog`；lite 会写到 `$TMPDIR/dsh-devin2api-client.log`。

- 没有 replay state；多轮只回放可见文本与工具调用。
- 一个插件实例只服务一个网关。
- `enabled` 需要重载。
- 浏览器 UI 不带鉴权；请使用 `auth.api_key` 为空的回环网关。
- UI 文案暂为中文。
- `contextWindow` 按模型取网关的 `context_length`（lite 新版本提供），旧网关或不带该字段的模型回落到配置值；`maxTokens` 仍是配置值，内置的 `modelMaxTokens` 只把 `swe-2` 系列降到 64k——网关不提供按模型输出上限。

```bash
npm install --legacy-peer-deps   # schema 测试用的 schemastery
npm test                         # 32 项测试
npm run check                    # 对 lib/*.js 跑 node --check
```
